Program Description Event Description Gerald’s topic, "A Brief Reintroduction of Native Americans into Illinois," is a program sponsored by the McHenry Public Library. He will discuss the reintroduction of his family into Illinois, tribal customs, the history of the tribe, modern natives, naming ceremonies, stereotypes, environmental concerns, tribal settlements, and reservations. Gerald is a past Illinois Humanities Road Scholar Speaker, an Illinois America 250 commissioner, and a past school board member.
